A skilled fighter can cause immense damage with this.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 16 |durability = 12 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Spiked Boko Bat}} Spiked Boko Bats are upgraded [[Boko Bat]]s that [[Bokoblin]]s decided to attach sharp spikes to. Despite their simplicity, skilled fighters can cause a good amount of damage using these [[Weapon]]s. They are commonly used by [[Blue Moblin]]s and [[Blue Bokoblin]]s in [[East Necluda]] and the [[Faron Grasslands]]. They also have a chance of appearing inside [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn after scanning the {{BotW|-}} Series [[Bokoblin]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. These Bats are part considered [[Bokoblin Gear]], an equipment archetype that includes all [[Weapon]]s created by Bokoblins.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Due to being made of wood, Spiked Boko Bats will float when they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. However, will burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].
